title: Conversation Archive: connected knowledge, traceable evidence
data_policy: Invented examples only; no personal archive or account content.

beats.title: Conversation Archive
beats.caption:
Turn scattered conversations into connected knowledge.
Keep the evidence behind every connection.
beats.script_en: Your conversations contain projects, people, and decisions. Conversation Archive helps connect those records while preserving the evidence behind them.

beats.title: Preserve what was actually said
beats.caption:
Keep original text, source locations, and branches.
A draft or an assistant suggestion is not a confirmed event.
beats.script_en: Start with exported conversations. Preserve original text, source locations, and branches. Keep user statements separate from drafts and assistant suggestions.

beats.title: Related does not mean identical
beats.caption:
Entries can share a project, person, theme, or period.
Link them without merging distinct events.
beats.script_en: Several entries may belong to the same project without describing the same event. Proposed connections stay uncertain until their support is established.

beats.title: Prepare questions. Then ask.
beats.caption:
Prepare 15 contextual questions before asking.
Read excerpts, confirm a subset, or leave a case unsure.
beats.script_en: Prepare fifteen questions together, with titles, source excerpts, and known references. Answer the whole batch without waiting for another round of grouping.

beats.title: One answer becomes a reusable rule
beats.caption:
Apply a confirmation only to its stated scope.
Keep the history, and revoke dependent links when needed.
beats.script_en: One clarification can connect several references. The rule stays scoped and reversible. Related entries keep their original text and their separate identities.

beats.title: Store structure. Generate views.
beats.caption:
Target: structured records are authoritative.
Rebuild SQLite retrieval and readable views from them.
beats.script_en: The target is structured records and correction history as authority, with SQLite retrieval and readable views on demand. A local migration is reported, but is not shipped in this baseline.

beats.title: AI agents: start here
beats.caption:
Read AGENTS.md, choose your task, and run the demo.
The offline example needs no API key or paid model call.
beats.script_en: For an AI agent, start with the operating contract and task map. Run the offline synthetic example, then open only the guide needed for your task.
